model_annotation: The figure presents two line plots comparing the training rewards of two models—Llama-On-Policy-Easy and Llama-LUFFY-Easy on the Easy Training Set, and Llama-On-Policy-Hard and Llama-LUFFY-Hard on the Hard Training Set—across a range of steps. Both plots share a common x-axis labeled "Steps," which spans from 0 to 500 on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 100. The y-axis, labeled "Training Rewards," is scaled from 0.0 to 0.4 on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. In the top plot for the Easy Training Set, the Llama-On-Policy-Easy model (solid blue line) begins with a training reward of approximately 0.0 and steadily increases, reaching a value of about 0.4 by 500 steps. The Llama-LUFFY-Easy model (solid red line) also starts at approximately 0.0 and increases, but its performance is slightly lower, reaching a final reward of about 0.35. In the bottom plot for the Hard Training Set, the Llama-On-Policy-Hard model (solid blue line) starts at 0.0 and remains at 0.0 until approximately 100 steps, after which it increases slightly to a final value of about 0.05. The Llama-LUFFY-Hard model (solid red line) starts at 0.0, rises to a peak of about 0.15 around 100 steps, then fluctuates, ending at a value of approximately 0.2.
